justification: The essay demonstrates a strong, sustained voice with deep commitment to the topic, evidenced by passionate declarations like 'Softball has to be one of the single most greatest sports alive' [span-ext-a10eff501df3] and describing teammates as 'like family' [span-ext-df61729620ec]. The writer brings the topic to life through vivid, original expressiveness regarding physical symptoms of nervousness ('mouth became bone dry... sticky mess') [span-ext-80350409f9f2] and shows a strong sense of audience awareness by reflecting on social dynamics ('didn't sound snobby or a grump') [span-ext-3c6d6792d6e7]. With 13 supporting excerpts and no counter-evidence across all facets, the voice is consistent and engaging, meeting Score 5 criteria.
